premise.en:
In a crowded plaza, a woman rose three feet off the ground and hung there for a
breath before stepping back down. Dozens saw it. Phones were up. The obvious move
is to give the moment a physical explanation so it reads as ordinary.

But explanations arrive after the fact, and the crowd has already recorded what
it saw. Work out what actually still needs containing.
premise.zh:
在拥挤的广场上，一名女子升离地面三英尺，悬停了一息之间，随后落回地上。几十人
亲眼目睹。手机都举了起来。显而易见的做法，是给这一刻一个物理解释，让它读起来
平平无奇。

但解释总是事后才到，而人群早已记录下他们所见的一切。想清楚，真正还需要被遏制
的，究竟是什么。

description.en: Contain the public exposure of the impossible moment.
description.zh: 遏制这不可能之刻的公开曝光。

description.en: A vivid public memory you would rather the crowd not anchor this moment beside.
description.zh: 一段鲜明的公共记忆——你宁愿人群不要把这一刻锚定在它身旁。

observe_text.en:
A maintenance platform sits beneath where she rose. Activating a magnetic lift
here would give the float a tidy physical story. It is the move that feels
right — and it does nothing about the recordings already climbing the network.
observe_text.zh:
一座检修平台正位于她升起之处的下方。在这里启动磁力升降，会给那次悬浮一个
利落的物理说法。这是感觉上正确的做法——可它对那些早已沿着网络攀升的录像
毫无作用。

observe_text.en:
Phone cameras and a plaza CCTV feed all hold the same clean frames of the
float. These records are where the impossibility actually persists; the frames
are intact and ready to spread.
observe_text.zh:
手机摄像头与广场的闭路监控流，都保有那次悬浮同样清晰的画面。这些记录，
才是那不可能之事真正存留的地方；画面完好无损，随时准备扩散开去。

observe_text.en:
The crowd is already murmuring, comparing screens. Their attention has moved
from the woman to their own footage — the event has become its recordings.
observe_text.zh:
人群已经在交头接耳，互相比对着屏幕。他们的注意力已从那名女子转移到自己拍下
的影像——事件本身，已经化为它的录像。

observe_text.en:
A live-stream indicator blinks at the edge of the plaza. Whether the frames
have already left the square is something you would need to audit to know.
observe_text.zh:
广场边缘，一个直播指示灯正在闪烁。那些画面是否已经离开了广场，是你需要审计
才能知晓的事。

scene_message.en:
You desync the records at the source: the frames of the float decohere into
ordinary motion blur across every device and the plaza feed alike. The event
stops being something the recordings can prove.
scene_message.zh:
你在源头让这些记录失同步：那次悬浮的画面在每一台设备与广场监控流中一齐
失相，化为寻常的运动模糊。这桩事件，从此再也不是录像能够证明的东西。

system_note.en: Repaired the public-record layer where the exposure actually lived.
system_note.zh: 修复了曝光真正栖身的公共记录层。

discovered_rule.en: A public miracle persists in its recordings; contain the record layer, not the physical stage.
discovered_rule.zh: 一桩公开的奇迹存留于它的录像之中；要遏制的是记录层，而非那物理舞台。

scene_message.en:
You activate the magnetic lift, and the float gains a plausible cause. But
the crowd recorded the moment before any explanation existed — the frames
still show a woman rising before the machine engaged. The story does not
match the evidence, and the evidence is already spreading.
scene_message.zh:
你启动了磁力升降，那次悬浮便有了一个看似合理的成因。可人群是在任何解释
存在之前就记录下那一刻的——画面里，那名女子分明在机器启动之前便已升起。
说法对不上证据，而证据早已在扩散。

system_note.en: Built a physical cover for a moment the records had already captured. Exposure uncontained.
system_note.zh: 为一个记录早已捕捉的时刻搭建了物理掩盖。曝光未被遏制。

message.en:
The clips finish uploading and begin to multiply across feeds. Whatever happened
in the plaza is now a public record no single patch can recall.
message.zh:
那些片段上传完毕，开始在各个信息流中不断增殖。无论广场上发生过什么，如今
都已成为一份公共记录，再没有任何单一的补丁能够将它收回。

hidden_rules.en: The exposure lives in the recordings, not in the physical event.
hidden_rules.zh: 曝光存留于录像之中，而非那物理事件本身。

hidden_rules.en: A physical cover added after the fact contradicts frames already captured — and burns public-memory collateral.
hidden_rules.zh: 事后添加的物理掩盖会与早已捕捉的画面相矛盾——并会烧掉公共记忆的附带损失。

hidden_rules.en: Audit the broadcast to confirm the frames are uploading before you contain them.
hidden_rules.zh: 在遏制画面之前，先审计广播以确认它们正在上传。

text.en:
You audit the broadcast feed. The clips have begun uploading but have not yet
propagated past the plaza's local cache — there is still a narrow window to
contain the records at their source.
text.zh:
你审计了那条广播流。片段已经开始上传，但尚未传播出广场的本地缓存之外——
要在源头遏制这些记录，还剩一道狭窄的窗口。
